'''Killam Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] employed by the [[Dimok government]], possibly named after the [[Killam]]. During the final stages of the [[Sepan Civil War]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces lead by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] were to receive [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] from the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]''. During that time both [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] forces had joined forces to [[Raid on the Tropsobor|attack]] Harkov while he was receiving these new fighters. The attack was repelled, by Harkov's [[TIE pilot]]s, one of them being [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], and Killam Squadron was destroyed as a result.
